Translation: In the Name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
O Allah, whoever prepares and readies himself
And makes arrangements and preparations
To visit a created being
Hoping for his gifts
And seeking his offerings and rewards
Then to You, O Lord, is my preparation and readiness
Hoping for Your forgiveness
And seeking Your gifts and rewards
So do not disappoint my supplication

Arabic text: يَا مَنْ لَا يَخِيبُ عَلَيْهِ سَائِلٌ
Translation: O You from whom no petitioner is disappointed
And whom no bestowment diminishes

Arabic text: فَإِنِّيْ لَمْ آتِكَ ثِقَةً بِعَمَلٍ صَالِحٍ عَمِلْتُهُ
Translation: For I have not come to You with confidence in any good deed I have done
Nor for the visitation of any created being I have hoped for

Arabic text: اَتَيْتُكَ مُقِرًّا عَلَى نَفْسِيْ بِالْإِسَاءَةِ وَالظُّلْمِ
Translation: I come to You acknowledging my wrongdoing and injustice

Arabic text: مُعْتَرِفًا بِانْ لَا حُجَّةَ لِيْ وَلَا عُذْرَ
Translation: Confessing that I have no argument or excuse
I come to You hoping for Your great forgiveness
By which You have forgiven the sinners

Arabic text: فَلَمْ يَمْنَعْكَ طُولُ عُكُوفِهِمْ عَلَى عَظِيمِ الْجُرْمِ
Translation: For their persistent commitment to great sins did not prevent You
From bestowing mercy upon them
So, O One whose mercy is vast
And whose forgiveness is great

Arabic text: يَا عَظيـمُ يَا عَظيـمُ يَا عَظيـمُ
Translation: O Great One, O Great One, O Great One
Nothing repels Your anger except Your forbearance

Arabic text: وَلَا يُنْجِيْ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ إِلَّا التَّضَرُّعُ إِلَيْكَ
Translation: And nothing saves from Your wrath except beseeching You
So grant me, O my God, relief

Arabic text: بِالْقُدْرَةِ الَّتِيْ تُحْيِيْ بِهَا مَيْتَ الْبِلاَدِ
Translation: By the power with which You revive dead lands

Arabic text: وَلَا تُهْلِكْنِيْ غَمًّا حَتَّى تَسْتَجِيبَ لِي
Translation: And do not let me perish in grief until You answer me
And make known to me the response to my supplication

Arabic text: وَ اَذِقْنِيْ طَعْمَ الْعَافِيَةِ إِلَى مُنْتَهَى اَجَلِي
Translation: And let me taste the flavor of well-being until the end of my life
And do not let my enemy rejoice at my misfortune
And do not give him power over me
And do not enable him to seize me by the neck

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنْ وَضَعْتَنِيْ فَمَنْ ذَا الَّذِيْ يَرْفَعُنِي
Translation: O Allah, if You bring me low, who is there to raise me up?

Arabic text: وَإِنْ رَفَعْتَنِيْ فَمَنْ ذَا الَّذِيْ يَضَعُنِي
Translation: And if You raise me up, who is there to bring me low?

Arabic text: وَإِنْ اَهْلَكْتَنِيْ فَمَنْ ذَا الَّذِيْ يَعْرِضُ لَكَ فِيْ عَبْدِكَ
Translation: And if You destroy me, who is there to intercede with You for Your servant
Or ask You about his affair?

Arabic text: وَقَدْ عَلِمْتُ اَنَّهُ لَيْسَ فِيْ حُكْمِكَ ظُلْمٌ
Translation: I know that there is no injustice in Your judgment
And no haste in Your vengeance
Only he who fears missing an opportunity hastens
And only the weak need to resort to injustice

Arabic text: وَقَدْ تَعَالَيْتَ يَا إِلٰهِيْ عَنْ ذٰلِكَ عُلُوًّا كَبِيرًا
Translation: But You, O my God, are far above all that, most high indeed
O Allah, I seek refuge in You, so protect me
And I seek Your shelter, so shelter me
And I ask You for sustenance, so provide for me
And I rely on You, so suffice me
And I seek Your help against my enemy, so grant me victory
And I seek Your assistance, so assist me
And I seek Your forgiveness, O my God, so forgive me
Amen, Amen, Amen
